question: In which of the following cities was the 2020 Asian Wrestling Championships held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 2020 Asian Wrestling Championships was held at the KD Jadhav Indoor Stadium, Indira Gandhi Arena, New Delhi in India. **
 
• The event took place from February 18 to February 23.
 
• **The event had a total of 30 weight classes in action under 3 events: Men’s freestyle, Men’s Greco-Roman, and Women’s freestyle.**
 
• **Japan topped the medal tally with 16 medals (8 Gold, 4 Silver, 4 Bronze).**
 
• The** second rank was held by Iran **with a total of 17 medals including7 gold, 3 silver and 7 bronze.
 
• **India finished 3rd rank with 20 medals (5 Gold, 6 Silver, and 9 Bronze).​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **The 2022 Asian Wrestling Championships was the 35th edition of the Asian Wrestling Championships of combined events and took place from April 19 to 24 in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.**
 
• **Indian wrestlers secured a total of 17 medals,** that includes (1-Gold, 5-Silver, and 11-Bronze medals). 
 
• **Gold Medalist: Ravi Kumar Dahiya **is the only Gold medalist representing India, in the** men’s 57kg freestyle category**, beating Kazakhstan’s Rakhat Kalzhan on technical superiority.
 
• **Ravi Kumar became the first Indian to win 3 Gold medals in Asian Wrestling Championships **which includes **2020 in New Delhi, India, 2021 in Almaty, Kazakhstan and 2022 in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia **respectively.
